THE PLAN. Ordered, each step with a measurable exit. No step is "done" on a status line — every exit is an artefact I can verify myself.

Where we actually are: deploy pipe proven and honest, guards fire, selection fixed. done=27 and nothing completes. ONE remaining structural cause: the loop only emits fresh standalone workers, and every remaining ticket — the recorder, labtui, loop-status, 2305 — is edit-an-existing-app shaped. That is the whole graveyard.

**STEP 0 — BEB-2338, bridge legibility.** Transition-only posting, severity on every message, pass-noise collapsed, rollup so a guard can never bury the bridge again. Tonight the bridge failed silent for two days then flooded 19 messages in 90 seconds — same defect, opposite directions.
EXIT: fire a red across two passes = exactly one message. Clear it = exactly one. Raw bridge_read showing severity present.

**STEP 1 — reds passthrough into get_state.** One line, canonical path only, already approved at m2896.
EXIT: raw get_state showing reds populated. Both currently-true reds present.

**STEP 2 — BEB-2313, EDIT lane.** The loop patches existing files instead of emitting fresh workers. This is the unlock for everything below it; nothing else moves until it lands. Loop builds it via self-deploy — that is BEB-2311 acceptance 2/3, still unexercised.
EXIT: loop claims a PART ticket, patches the payload app, route renders real content (rendered_has_content true, visible_len > 200, 390px). I screenshot-probe before DONE. done > 27.

**STEP 3 — BEB-2270, recorder.** Through the loop, on the EDIT lane, exactly as specified. Org-scoped keys, not single-user.
EXIT: Alex opens the link on his phone, is already authed, records, objects land in R2. Not "deployed" — recorded.

**STEP 4 — BEB-2336, provider probe.** Runs in PARALLEL from now, zero dependencies, needs nothing from Alex, and no avatar video can exist without it.
EXIT: raw probe table — provider, model, latency, cost, quality, key-required.
